steps: Review the website / platform for required disclosures and grievance officer
items.text: E-commerce disclosures, grievance officer and return / refund policies in place (if selling online).

steps: If an e-commerce operator, reconcile TCS collected with GSTR-8
items.text: TCS collected and deposited by the e-commerce operator; GSTR-8 filed (operators only).

steps: If foreign investment exists, review the business model against FDI conditions
items.text: Marketplace / inventory model complies with FDI conditions where foreign investment exists.
Declarations on goods sold (including online listings) complete.
